rules.reason_if_failed: VAT MTD is mandatory for VAT-registered businesses only. If you're not VAT-registered, you don't need to enrol for VAT MTD.
Your turnover is below the VAT threshold. VAT MTD only applies if you are VAT-registered.

rules.description: Self-employed or landlord with income over £50,000 (for Income Tax MTD from April 2026)
rules.reason_if_failed: Income Tax MTD applies to self-employed individuals and landlords with annual income over £50,000 from April 2026.

rules.description: Must use or intend to use MTD-compatible software
rules.reason_if_failed: You must use MTD-compatible software to keep digital records and submit returns. Choose software before enrolling.

rules.description: Must be a UK tax resident or have UK tax obligations
rules.reason_if_failed: MTD applies to UK tax residents and those with UK tax obligations.

rules.description: Not digitally exempt or excluded from MTD
rules.reason_if_failed: You may be exempt from MTD. Contact HMRC to discuss your circumstances.

edge_cases.description: Person cannot use digital services due to age, disability, or location
edge_cases.action: Route to HMRC exemption application. May be able to use alternative methods or get support.

edge_cases.description: Business is a partnership with complex structure
edge_cases.action: Each partner may need to enrol separately. Route to partnership MTD guidance.

edge_cases.description: Individual has multiple self-employed businesses or properties
edge_cases.action: All qualifying businesses/properties must be included in MTD. May need accountant support.

edge_cases.description: Business has overseas trading or tax obligations outside UK
edge_cases.action: Complex tax situation. Route to HMRC helpline for guidance on international MTD requirements.
